name: start_camera_fov_transition

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_StartCameraFovTransition reads two values from the Script value stack, stores the duration and target field of view, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: ScriptCommand_StartCameraFovTransition snapshots the current field of view from D_003C0E84, stores the requested field of view, and enables transition flag 0x8. func_001CA7A0 derives a per-tick increment from the starting field of view, target, and duration; it advances and clamps the active value, rebuilds the camera projection, and clears the flag at the target. All 73 JP calls transition to 53 degrees. Fifty-six calls immediately follow command 51 start_camera_distance_transition with the same duration; the remaining 17 independently use a duration of five ticks.
